title: The Pale Physician's Wager
text: A plague doctor in a bone-white beak arrives with the fever close behind him. He offers a wager to one House: send someone to sit the night with the dying, and if they are still themselves at dawn, he will drive the fever out. If not, he keeps them.

options.label: Send a Scion to sit the night with the dying, and take the doctor's wager.

outcomes.text: Your Scion is still themselves at dawn, gaunt and grey but themselves. The doctor bows, and the fever leaves with him.
At dawn your Scion is not quite themselves. The doctor touches his beak to them, fondly, and leaves the fever behind as a gift.

options.label: Pay him to take the fever somewhere else. Let some other town bear it.

outcomes.text: He takes the gold and the fever both, and goes to the next town over. You hear nothing from that town again.

options.label: Lock the gates against him. No wager with a plague is worth taking.

outcomes.text: He waits outside the gates for three days. The fever doesn't.
